Package hadur117.core.move

Class FieldPrior

java.lang.Object
hadur117.core.move.FieldPrior
public final class FieldPrior extends Object
MOVE-35 (K1 step 3 of the road to king, docs/bench/gun-oracle.md): the field prior, a member of the danger that knows how learning guns shoot before this one has shown us anything. It is a table fitted offline on the oracle's bullets from many learning guns: for the state the enemy aimed at (our lateral speed, acceleration, wall room ahead and the bullet's flight time, each cut into a few bins) the share of their bullets that went to each guess factor. Against a new opponent the views are empty for the first rounds and the surf drives on a head-on guess; the prior puts the field's experience there from the first wave, and the rolling score weighs it down once the views have learnt this gun.

On the oracle's 48 learning guns the rolling blend with the prior scores +0.44 bits against +0.39 for views and aims alone, and the bullets from the third of the wave the model rated safest fall from 7.7% to 6.8%; in the first three rounds from 8.2-9.2% to 6.0-7.4%.

Pure: no engine types, no clock, no randomness, no state. Duel only, off unless the duel turns it on.

    Fields

    Field
    Description
    (package private) static final int
    MIN_BULLETS
    A cell with fewer bullets than this reads as the flat profile.
    (package private) static final double
    SMOOTH
    The share of the flat (all cells) profile mixed into each cell's, so a thin cell is not spiky.
    (package private) static final double
    WALL_STEP
    The oracle walks the orbit toward the wall in steps of this many escape angles and records the first step outside the field; the wave's distance is walked in hundredths, so it is rounded up to the same grid before binning, or a wall at 0.48 would read a different cell here than in the table.
